items.title: Voorbereiding Eredivisie: Feyenoord in derde oefenduel opnieuw tegen Belgen
items.summary: In dit overzicht zetten we de oefenprogramma's van de Eredivisie-clubs op een rijtje. Het nieuwe seizoen in de Eredivisie begint op 7 augustus met de wedstrijd SC Cambuur - Excelsior.

items.title: Oranje-beul Marokko houdt vertrouwen in bondscoach
items.summary: Mohamed Ouahbi is ook na het wereldkampioenschap de bondscoach van Marokko. Dat bevestigde de Marokkaanse voetbalbond donderdagavond. Met het nationale elftal strandde Ouahbi in de kwartfinale tegen Frankrijk.

items.title: FC Twente treft omnisportclub met Amsterdammer en bekende vedette
items.summary: Als FC Twente het later deze maand tweemaal opneemt tegen Ferencváros in de tweede voorronde van de Europa League, staan de Tukkers tegenover de nodige spelers met een verleden op Nederlandse bodem. De Hongaarse recordkampioen, die FK Vojvodina uitschakelde en tot tegenstander van Ajax maakte, herbergt bovendien een Amsterdammer en een alom bekend gezicht in de selectie.

items.title: Atlético-president bespreekt Álvarez-geruchten: 'Onze speler, ook volgend seizoen'
items.summary: Een nieuw hoofdstuk in de transfersoap rondom Atlético Madrid-spits Julián Álvarez. Ditmaal heeft clubpresident Enrique Cerezo zich uitgelaten over de toekomst van de Argentijn. De 78-jarige Spanjaard was duidelijk: wat hem betreft gaat Álvarez helemaal nergens heen.

items.title: Potentieel MLS-debuut Lewandowski uitgesteld door gevolgen van natuurgeweld
items.summary: Robert Lewandowski moet nog minimaal enkele dagen wachten voor hij zijn officiële debuut voor Chicago Fire kan maken. De club zou oorspronkelijk in de nacht van donderdag op vrijdag zijn eerste wedstrijd sinds de WK-stop spelen, maar in Chicago worden de gevolgen van flinke bosbranden in Canada ook gevoeld.

items.title: New York issues air quality alert days before World Cup final
items.summary: Officials in New York and New Jersey issue an air quality health alert because of wildfire smoke just days before the World Cup final.

items.title: The bigger picture: Tuchel gets blame for England exit but this is not only about him | Barney Ronay
items.summary: German will be pilloried for his semi-final decisions but that is to ignore the fact English football culture is not set up to win major tournaments “I wanted it to be you. I wanted it to be you so badly.” As England’s World Cup hopes recede into another spell of heartache, let down in Atlanta by the latest handsome, cadaverous Mr Right, a little sadder, not much wiser, sunburnt, broke, eating Jägerbomb ice cream out of the tub with a spoon, this is a good moment to seek some classic New York romcom solace. Meg Ryan was right. Don’t be sad that it’s over. Be incredibly angry and frustrated on the radio that it happened at all. Continue reading...

items.title: Romero’s World Cup heroics for Argentina make him one of Messi’s most trusted
items.summary: The mercurial performance at the back was a far cry from the gaffe-prone Spurs captain we have become accustomed to seeing As Cristian Romero readied to receive a pass 10 yards from his goalline, Jude Bellingham and Anthony Gordon sensed a mistake in the making. The center-back’s posture was not ideal after he took a scoot backwards to collect, facing the left sideline as his opponents lustily converged. He would only have half a second to settle a bouncing ball, shift his momentum, and find a passing lane in the rapidly closing seam between the England duo. Easier said than done on most days, but this particular Wednesday was not most days. First touch: ball settled. Second touch: right foot shunting the ball to his left. Third touch: left foot, ball coolly slotted to an awaiting Nahuel Molina. Continue reading...

items.title: Some England players disappointed at tactics as Tuchel questions team's DNA
items.summary: BBC Sport understands that Thomas Tuchel's defensive tactics in the World Cup semi-final defeat to Argentina are being hotly debated by the England squad.

items.title: Fifa 'assessing match reports' over Falklands banner
items.summary: Fifa is "assessing the match reports" before deciding whether to punish Argentina after players held a banner in support of their country's claims to the Falkland Islands.

items.title: Tuchel ‘100%’ invested in leading England at Euro 2028 despite semi-final failure
items.summary: Manager under fire for manner of 2-1 defeat by Argentina ‘There is enough to improve and I am happy to do that’ Thomas Tuchel says he is “100%” committed to leading England at Euro 2028 and finding the “extra level” for glory that eluded his team at the World Cup. The manager is under fire for the manner of Wednesday’s 2-1 semi-final defeat in Atlanta. His switch to a back five for the final quarter at 1-0 up did not work, Argentina scoring two late goals to advance into Sunday’s final against Spain. Continue reading...

items.title: What next for England? How does Tuchel fix key problems for Euro 2028?
items.summary: The manner of England's World Cup exit was meek, and Thomas Tuchel must now find a way to fix those problems as focus will soon turn to qualifying for Euro 2028.

items.title: Dominik Szoboszlai agrees Liverpool deal as Aston Villa go for João Gomes
items.summary: Szoboszlai set to hand Andoni Iraola a boost Leeds close to signing centre-back Muharemovic Dominik Szoboszlai is poised to give Liverpool and their head coach, Andoni Iraola, a significant boost by signing a new long-term contract. The midfielder, who was the team’s best performer during a difficult final season under Arne Slot, has two years on his deal and mentioned several times last season that there had been no real progress over an extension. After months of negotiations between Liverpool’s sporting director, Richard Hughes, and Szoboszlai’s representatives, the terms of a new contract have been agreed in principle and the 25-year-old is close to signing the deal. Continue reading...

items.title: Keir Starmer wants Fifa investigation into Argentina players who held Falklands banner
items.summary: Spokesperson says islands belong to the UK ‘PM wishes both teams well for the final, especially Spain’ Keir Starmer supports the idea of Fifa investigating Argentina players who displayed a banner touting their country’s claim to the Falklands Islands after their World Cup semi-final win against England, Downing Street has said. Starmer, who watched the match while travelling to Ukraine by train for the final overseas trip of his premiership, endorsed a call by Peter Kyle, the business secretary, for Fifa to investigate what rules may have been broken. Continue reading...

items.title: How coach-on-pitch Messi undid England's tactics on the fly
items.summary: England pride themselves on their physicality, so shouldn't it have suited them to face a 39-year-old who spends most of his time walking? Not this 39-year-old. BBC Sport football tactics correspondent Umir Irfan explores a Lionel Messi masterclass.

items.title: Le Club de Bruges n'est plus seul : un grand club veut s'offrir un talent de Genk
